method: 2025-26 linked player points/minute shrunk toward D1 mean by historical minutes; historical per-game minutes capped at 40 and team sum normalized to <=200, unobserved minutes scored at mean; team quality centered; 300 Elo per PPM difference is experimental, not historically calibrated.
limitations: Not opponent-adjusted; prior school conference quality still missing

Projection uses past minutes, not fitted playing time model
Only box-scored D1 players included; remaining rotation at league average
Historical as-of preseason sources not certified
Does not supersede published roster-informed preseason Elo
